visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short brown hair, wearing a yellow knit sweater with floral patterns and small hoop earrings, stands in a modern kitchen. She holds a white and transparent blender unit. The background features dark grey shaker-style cabinets and a white countertop. (2) Scene cuts to the woman in a light purple t-shirt, using a knife to cut green fruit (guava) into cubes on a white cutting board. (3) A close-up shot focuses on the blender base as it operates, whirring the cubed fruit with liquid into a pale green mixture. (4) The woman in the yellow sweater returns, holding up the white lid assembly of the blender to show a four-pronged stainless steel blade. (5) Fast cuts show the woman pouring dark liquid into a smaller blender cup and then blending a thick, reddish-purple smoothie. (6) The woman stands in the kitchen holding three clear plastic blender cups of varying sizes, smiling at the camera. (7) Dressed in a grey hoodie, the woman takes a spoonful of the purple smoothie from a cup, looking delighted. (8) A series of close-ups demonstrate three different lids: one with a carry handle, one with a straw, and a flat storage lid. (9) The woman demonstrates the portability of the cup with the handle lid, then the leak-proof nature of the straw lid. (10) The woman is seen cutting more fruit, followed by a product shot of the blender and its accessories on the counter. (11) Final shot shows the woman holding a promotional graphic overlay while speaking to the camera.

(2) Percussive thud sounds at 0:01 as a knife hits a cutting board. (3) Mechanical whirring of a blender motor occurs at 0:02, layered over the continuous narration. (4) Short 'whoosh' transition SFX at 0:06. (5) A sharp 'pop' or hissing sound at 0:11 as a bottle is opened. (6) Slushy, bubbling blending sounds at 0:12 during smoothie preparation. (7) A slight laughter/exhale from the speaker at 0:17 as she tastes the drink. (8) Mechanical 'click' sound at 0:19 when showing the first lid. (9) Another 'click' sound at 0:25 for the second lid. (10) A third 'click' and friction sound at 0:31 for the final lid. (11) Repetitive chopping sounds return at 0:36. (12) Voice shifts to a direct call-to-action tone at 0:43 with a slightly lower, more persuasive pitch while the BGM remains upbeat.
